module: Node "Follow Decalroad" (color ai, duration behavior). Simply makes a vehicle follow a DecalRoad: builds a path from the road nodes (time = distance / data.speed) and starts ai.startFollowing. Inputs: flow, start, stop, roadName, vehId, loopCount (hidden). Outputs: flow, active, finished, progress (0 to 1). Data: renderDebug, speed (5 m/s), loopMode ("startReset").
notes: Bug: in onVehicleSubmitInfo, self.pinOut.active and self.pinOut.finished are replaced by booleans (instead of .value), which overwrites the pin objects.
Bug: when info == nil, the function continues and reads info.scriptTime (error); a return is missing.
The last node of the road is not added to the path (the loop goes from 0 to getNodeCount()-2), and the end is never detected by flow.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Initializes the data (speed=5, loopMode=startReset, renderDebug=false) and asks all vehicles to emit the onVehicleSubmitInfo hook with their ai.scriptState().

onVehicleSubmitInfo.desc: Hook called with the AI script state of a vehicle; updates progress = scriptTime / endScriptTime and receivedInfo if the id matches vehId.

info.desc: AI script state (scriptTime, endScriptTime) or nil.

getVeh.desc: Returns the vehicle whose id is given as input, or the player's vehicle (getPlayerVehicle(0)) without input.

play.desc: Loads the road, sends ai.startFollowing(path, nil, loopCount or -1, loopMode) and initializes the finished, active and progress pins.

stop.desc: Sends ai.stopFollowing() and sets finished/active to false.

loadRecording.desc: Builds self.path from the DecalRoad (scenetree.findObject(roadName)): one point per node with the cumulative time and the direction/up of the first point.

work.desc: Calls play on start, or stop on stop.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays Load button, state, number of nodes, distance and debug path if renderDebug.
